groups.why: All four check the same thing: the Measures in the search result appear in the saved Measure Setting order.
Same target (Save/OK in the column and Measure Setting popups), same condition (no changes) and same expected result (no re-search).
Same check: a user with no saved personalization switches Div and gets that Div's UI Category Default columns and Measures.
The target is 'clear after save' but the expected result is 'Column button', which matches no other row, so it stays alone.
It is the only row that saves personalization with a required column removed in one Div and then checks another Div.
Its mixed expectations (row count matches AS-IS, Team shown as Name, columns follow the popup settings) are not shared by any other row.
Only this row checks that the grid columns rebuild right away when Column Setting OK is pressed.
Specific columns: VERSION removed from the setting list, and AS FROM SITE hidden for Div 40.
Checks whether specific Measures are in the Measure Setting list for each Div (VMI and MKT FCST AMT), which no other row does.
Only checks that the Default button restores the default columns; it does not include V-588c6a7f's save → close → reopen state, so kept separate.
Checks two things after save → close → reopen: the new tab is kept, and Default means the original default. Neither the state nor the expected result matches V-3fa0f08f.
Same red, locked required-column check as V-c6b9a0fc, but it also expects user-selected columns to appear in the result, so it is not grouped to avoid dropping that check.
The condition is a Div 40→81→40 switch and the expected result covers only red required columns and the multilingual message, so it is not the same as V-709e3edf.
Checks the state right after opening the screen, before Search: the setting candidates are re-queried when Division is auto-selected. No other row checks this state.
Expects the Measure Setting button to be removed. That is the opposite of the Measure order rows, which assume the button exists.
Only this row checks that internal columns such as COL_LIST are not shown in the search grid.
This screen rule bundles several items into one expected result, so it does not match any single row exactly.
Only this row checks the Measure name 'MKT FCST[R+P]'.
